dedupe_keys.name: customers experiencing a power outage in counties of california 2019

description: Shenyue Jia and colleagues publish California power-outage customer counts derived from PowerOutage.us for 2019. Zenodo offers fifty-eight county CSV files under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The deposit describes a ten-minute time series with counts of customers experiencing an outage at city and county level from 1 January to 31 December. These observations can calibrate outage, restoration and equity simulations across California counties. Related catalogue records include EAGLE-I outage estimates and a derived US county-day corpus; those use different providers or aggregation and do not replace this PowerOutage.us series. A limitation is that vendor coverage and reporting delays may vary by utility and place, while the page does not state a county-specific quality index. The data report customer counts, not causes or asset-level failures. No CSV was downloaded, and completeness and outage duration were not independently checked.
